summary:
Alembic Main rootcause6 single combined downstream repair. Start only from clean Alembic@8f7e179f11e5c48366e6a26c9d1ce519f1f45ea2 with exact local AlembicCore@96655b9bbd56f22381ffa7f48a6cd52cabc5a1da and AlembicAgent@3c95549bb82aa011216d6d3be0f41741ba42d5ad. The controller reproduced the real consumer break: npm run build:check has eight errors across StrictAnalysisRuntime, StrictPrivateCorpusRuntime and StrictFinalizationRuntime—old hypothesis reviewerReceiptId, incomplete population/observation shapes, old two-argument integrity validators, missing runtimeReceiptHash in private revision initialization, and obsolete InvestigatedEmpty input.

Repair the existing Main strict production chain in place; do not add a parallel analysis/proof/store/finalizer. Main must consume the exact Core executor receipts and accepted Agent semantic contracts: build complete ObservationPopulation denominator rows with executionReceipts and all accepted/duplicate/excluded/error/inspected-no-pattern/variant/outlier/negative-control/subject-parent fields; preserve Analyst-owned cross-subject cluster proposals instead of caller/string structural completion; bind current analysis review context, canonical KnowledgeDispositionReview receipts and induction→falsification/disposition→producer eligibility; derive context dispositionReviewIds from actual conserved review receipts, never hypothesis string fields.

Connect Producer 0/1/N results to Main's existing serial expression-or-disposition journal loop. Every canonical row must run G1, non-persisting admission, independent disposition review or G2, deterministic private persistence/ref reconciliation/contentReady, then close the accepted Core HypothesisExpressionSet receipt with exact terminal fates and no unresolved row. Main remains the sole owner of admission, G1/G2, private revision, persistence, coverage, finalization and CAS; Agent only supplies cognition/semantic lineage. Investigated-empty must use real executionReceipts, a current-context Core disposition review and nonempty complete obligations. PrivateCorpus initialize/rehydrate/checkpoint/integrity calls must validate exact current runId, fixpoint, revision, configReceiptHash and runtimeReceiptHash; invalidated/stale roots cannot reopen or contribute dedup/coverage.

Update the existing strict finalization and coverage path so the same accepted execution/population/cluster/induction/falsification/review/fixpoint/expression-set identities survive into G3, sealed private corpus, sparse/vector/G4, final coverage, serving snapshot validation, serving manifest and lock-inside-compare public CAS. Preserve the accepted strict state order, external recovery boundary and rootcause5 physical publication behavior. Remove or quarantine old strict fixture shapes only where the real Main consumer no longer accepts them; ordinary non-strict behavior and public package compatibility must not regress.

Add RED→GREEN tests for all controller-reproduced build failures and runtime rebinding/missing-chain/stale-context cases. Produce a fresh-process JSON proof through the actual Main strict entry/facade using the accepted public Core/Agent subpaths; deterministic host fixtures are allowed at LLM/external-data boundaries, but execution/review/population/fixpoint/admission/expression/finalization receipts may not be hand-built substitutes for the path under test. Run the full evidence contract and return one TargetResultEnvelope for controller review only.

Hard boundaries: modify only Alembic. Do not edit Core, Agent, Plugin, Dashboard, Design, Test, Wakeflow, vendor/gitlinks or caches; do not run real LLMs, real daemon quiesce/reset or touch real Ghost/data roots; do not claim Plugin/five-tool/Test/demand completion. If an accepted Core or Agent contract itself is insufficient, stop with the exact producer blocker instead of adding a Main fallback or deep import.

designIntent: 在 Alembic 现有 strict journal/orchestration、Gateway/KnowledgeService、private revision、finalizer 与 public CAS 链内，消费已接受的 Core/Agent semantic authority；保持 Main 为持久化、admission、G1/G2、revision、coverage 与 finalization 唯一宿主，不建立第二运行时或证据平台。

required.verify: One clean Alembic commit based on 8f7e179f11e5c48366e6a26c9d1ce519f1f45ea2; exact local AlembicCore 96655b9bbd56f22381ffa7f48a6cd52cabc5a1da and AlembicAgent 3c95549bb82aa011216d6d3be0f41741ba42d5ad; report parent/commit/tree and changed files.
Run build:check, focused strict analysis/private-corpus/finalization/facade suites, full npm run check, npm run build, repository/Core/Agent/layer/ring/shared-asset gates, and git diff --check.

Fresh-process Main public/production consumer starts from actual Core fact execution and accepted Agent semantic receipts, then proves Main serial G1→admission→disposition-review-or-G2→private persist/ref/contentReady→Core HypothesisExpressionSet closure, revision seal, G3/G4/final coverage/serving validation/manifest/public CAS lineage without synthetic receipt substitution.

Old structural population/string reviewer, execution/output/denominator rebinding, missing induction/falsification/review, incomplete population, stale run/fixpoint/revision/config/runtime rehydrate, orphan review, terminal expression omission, admission/G2/terminal mismatch and invalidated-root reuse fail closed at the owning seam.

Only Alembic source/tests/package-facing artifacts change; no AlembicCore/AlembicAgent/Plugin/Dashboard/Design/Test/Wakeflow/vendor/cache edits and no real LLM, daemon quiesce/reset, Ghost/data-root mutation or Test execution.
